svg.title: AIcoach — Other pages (r3-07 Stage Bands)
svg.text: One idea per screen. The swing sits on a dark band; the coach and your actions sit on paper.

g.text: Sign in to see your swings.

text.tspan: New here?
Create an account

g.text: Your swings are private to you.

text.tspan: Paper only: nothing to show of the swing yet.

g.text: Email and a password. Nothing else.

text.tspan: You can delete every swing, or the whole
account, from the Account page at any time.
Have an account?
Sign in
Two fields, one button, the deletion promise up
front.

g.text: 7 steps · about a minute to read

text.tspan: The set-up on the band; seven short steps on paper.
Whole body and club
in frame
Head to clubhead, from address to finish.
If your feet are cut off, the hips and
posture can’t be measured.
Dotted rings mark what must stay in frame.
No guess this time. Three things got in
the way, and each one has a fix.

g.text: No result was made. Nothing was saved.

text.tspan: The band shows why: no body lines, feet cut off.
None of the three faults crossed its
threshold. That is a real answer.
Weight appears to move toward the
trail side at the top.
Clean key frames, no drill. The unverified note
stays dashed.
AI
coach

g.text: 5 saved swings · only you can see them
Swipe a swing left to delete it.

text.tspan: Each saved clip keeps a small dark key frame and
its main finding.
Turn on “Save to my swing library” when
you upload. A saved clip stays on the
AIcoach server until you delete it.
Unsaved clips are deleted right after
the analysis.
Says what saving means before anything is saved.
Removes every analysis, result, key frame
and saved clip. You will not be able to
sign in again.
Delete one analysis or everything. Paper only.
Removes every analysis, result, key frame
and saved clip. You will not be able to
sign in again.
This removes 9 analyses with their results
and key frames, and 5 saved swing clips.
It cannot be undone.
A plain sheet: what goes, that it is final, a safe
way out.
